summary: The contract algebra, inspection and projection boundaries are well specified, but the concrete scalar library types and encodings are unnamed, so codecs, Dhall projection and stored bytes cannot yet be written.

questions.text: Which library types are recognised as DecimalScalar, DateScalar and InstantScalar (and money), and what canonical wire and Dhall encodings do they use?
questions.reason: Recogniser, codecs, Dhall projection, stored fact bytes and contract identities all depend on it; ADR 0005: 'A scalar adapter must select the library type, parameters, canonical encoding and semantic checks together' and ADR 0007 lists 'Documented strings' without documenting them.

questions.text: Are String and bounded integral types such as Int accepted as TextScalar/IntegerScalar, or only Text, Integer and Natural?
questions.reason: Lowered structurally, String is an unsupported List Char, yet ADR 0014's example uses 'reviewedIds :: [String]'; ADR 0007 says 'SDK identities, messages and textual payloads use Text' and ADR 0005 names only 'text and exact integer/decimal conventions'.

questions.text: How do constructors with two or more positional fields, and union cases with several fields, lower into Shape?
questions.reason: The choice fixes wire objects, Dhall fact encodings and contract identity; ADR 0005 covers only zero-field records and says it 'does not extend support to multi-element tuples', and ADR 0007 says 'a positional wrapper is tagged'.

questions.text: May a CollectionDecl reference field be Maybe FactId, [FactId] or nested in a sub-record or union payload, and how is a nested field named?
questions.reason: Decides the metadata format, the Reference annotation walker and generic link rendering; ADR 0005 gives only 'reference-field/target-collection pairs' and 'Reference shape checking verifies an ID's representation and declared target'.

questions.text: When may the ContractId encoding's version tag change, and what happens to persisted fingerprints in examples, candidates, archives and evidence after an upgrade changes it?
questions.reason: A tag change would invalidate every saved example and evidence capture compared by fingerprint; ADR 0005 only says identity is 'SHA-256 of a version-tagged JSON-array encoding', and ADR 0011 compares 'fingerprints before decoding saved values'.
